asset_id: quaternius_astronaut
category: characters (animation source)
description: Rigged + animated low-poly astronaut from Quaternius's Ultimate Animated Character pack (43-bone humanoid
             rig; Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Jump_Idle, Jump_Land, Wave, Yes, No, Duck, Punch, HitReact, Death, ... 18 takes).
             Only the skeleton motion is used: the takes are retargeted onto the chibi cast skeleton
             (Tools/dai/chibi/retarget.py); the astronaut mesh itself is not exported.
